beats.narration_text: Three terms. Reflection floor: An added baseline in the rim weight. Contrast power: An exponent applied to cubemap color. Lobe: A concentrated reflection contribution.

terms.meaning: An added baseline in the rim weight
An exponent applied to cubemap color

beats.narration_text: This shader extends a rim-weighted environment lookup. Intensity scales the angular part, while offset adds a baseline. The two controls are not interchangeable even when both make some regions brighter.

props.title: Trace The Model
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: With zero offset, a point facing the camera has zero geometric rim weight. A positive offset lets an environment contribution survive there, still multiplied by the diffuse-plus-ambient lighting factor.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: fresnel_offset

props.title: Give The Center Reflection
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: The contrast control raises each cubemap color component to a power. For components between zero and one, a power above one darkens intermediate values. This is an artistic operation, not a new reflection ray.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: pow(cube_map, vec3(reflection_contrast))

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: pow(cube_map, vec3(reflection_contrast))

shot.motion_claim: Highlight the exact source expression: pow(cube_map, vec3(reflection_contrast))

props.title: Reshape The Environment
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Two powers operate on the same reflection-light alignment. Their independently colored contributions add together. A smaller exponent gives a broader lobe; a larger exponent gives a tighter one.

shot.visual_intent: Highlight the exact source expression: specular_power2

show.event: Highlight the exact source expression: specular_power2

props.title: Two Highlight Lobes
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Watch the offset increase from zero to one half on the red demo material. Reflection appears more strongly on front-facing regions. The stored environment and the mesh remain the same.

show.event: Act: Test The Model. Raise The Offset

beats.narration_text: The reflection contribution and both highlights are added to the diffuse base. This makes the controls easy to inspect, but the sum is not an energy-conserving model of layered automotive paint.

props.title: Read The Sum
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Godot's vector power call uses a vector exponent here. The scalar contrast is explicitly expanded into three components. That is a language-porting detail, not an extra physical effect.

props.title: Types Matter
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Tune each term against a visible goal: reflection at the center, environment contrast, a broad sheen, or a tight highlight. Calling everything shininess hides which calculation you actually changed.

props.title: Tune With A Purpose
props.caption: Godot · recorded evidence

beats.narration_text: Let’s recap with Claude. Intensity scales the angle-based reflection term. Offset adds a reflection baseline before lighting. A power reshapes the cubemap color. Two specular lobes contribute separate highlights. Liam, in for Bear.
